title: Speaking for "Free": Word of Mouth in Free- and Paid-Product Settings
design_notes: Study 4 uses 5,665 apps listed on both Google Play and Apple's App Store, observed in September 2014 and March 2015. Model: differenced across platforms (Eq. 2) in NewReviews on Free, Low Volume, High Dispersion and their interactions, with ranking and rating controls, comparing two time points. Studies 1-3 are a survey and experiments.
eligible_reason: Two-period cross-platform difference design with interaction terms, count outcome and time-varying controls; no staggered adoption of a binary treatment.
screener_notes: App-store data on 6,300 randomly selected apps collected by the authors; no data availability statement or package found. Ineligible on design.
